name: io.github.vmedvedovskiy/luftpause
description: async/await for LLM agents: spawn and await sub-agents scheduled on your own GPUs

environmentVariables.name: Runtime__Model
environmentVariables.description: Model the sub-agents run on, as served by an engine behind the luftpause dataplane

environmentVariables.name: DataPlane__Url
environmentVariables.description: URL of the luftpause dataplane that places each turn on the engine pool

environmentVariables.name: LUFTPAUSE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required on the MCP endpoint and sent to the dataplane; unset leaves both open
